# Build How-To: Gauss Minigun Heavy Gunner / Heavy Weapons with Power Armor

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_144_nukaknights-post-build-heavy-gunner-gauss-minigun-pa.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build specializes in the **Gauss Minigun**, a **heavy** rotating **energy weapon** with explosion damage from the EK 2mm cartridges. To get the most out of this heavy weapon, this build plays in **Power Armor**. The “Stabilized” perk, which brings enormous advantages for heavy weapons, only works in PA. In fact, this **Build is playable both Bloodstained and Full Life**. In the full life version, the damage is slightly lower, but of course involves less risk. The choice of weapon is of course a little different. With the Full Life variant you rely on **double shot** instead of bloodstained, which is at least as good with the Gauss Minigun. However, the damage is of course higher even with a double shot in the bloodstained variant (e.g. due to the adrenal reaction mutation).

## Everything about the Gauss Minigun

The Gauss Minigun is a **heavy weapon** and an **energy weapon** that uses starting rotation of the barrel (so it doesn't fire immediately, but only after the barrel has reached maximum rotation). It cannot be traded and can therefore only be played on one char or placed in the stash. The Gauss Minigun has been available in Fallout 76 since April 2020 (Wastelanders Update). The Gauss Minigun can be crafted with just 2 legendary modules at the weapon workbench at **level 45 and 50**, giving you a random legendary variant with 1-3 stars. How quickly something useful comes out is a complete coincidence. The blueprint and mods can be purchased from the raiders in Crater (from Mortimer) at the highest reputation level for gold, or from Minerva in list 5/13/21/23 (Gauss Minigun) and mods in lists 1 and 17. The ammunition used is either **EK 2mm cartridges** or EK 2mm cartridges (Ultracite). The standard magazine holds 500 rounds. 

Once you've learned the plan for the Gauss Minigun, the weapon can drop (in addition to crafting it at the workbench) at Legendary events, from enemies, during Expeditions, Daily Operations, and from the Legendary Merchant.

Special feature: **The balls explode with 15% area damage**. This means perks that increase explosions can be used here (e.g. demolition expert & grenadier).

Available **Mods for the Gauss Minigun**:

- Standard barrel (best range, lower rate of fire)
- Triple barrel (84 less range, 18 more rate of fire, -7 precision)
- Quintuple barrel (84 less range, 15 less damage, -1 precision and 31 more rate of fire)
- Standard capacitor
- Premium Capacitor (Ammo: EK 2mm Cartridges (Ultracite), 25% damage in general & 60% more damage against Scorched and Incendiary Beasts)
- Tesla coil capacitor (+6 energy damage, +150 magazine capacity, fast reload, +5% AP consumption)
- Tesla coil dynamo (+3 energy damage, +250 magazine capacity, slow reload, +10% AP consumption)
- No visor
- Gunner sight (+15 precision, -15% AP consumption)

I always use the triple barrel, premium condenser (Tesla condenser works too), and of course the Gunner sight. The triple barrel reduces the range drastically, but I don't play the heavy gunner anyway
